message.content: The “best” movie of 2020 can vary depending on who you ask—critics, audiences, or specific genres—but one film that consistently topped lists and received widespread acclaim is **“Parasite”** (though it was released in 2019, it had a significant impact in 2020). If you’re looking for a 2020 release that many consider the standout of that year, **“Tenet”** (directed by Christopher Nolan) and **“Soul”** (by Pixar) were both highly praised. For a more niche or genre‑specific pick, **“The Invisible Man”** (horror) and **“The Trial of the Chicago 7”** (drama) were also highlighted as top films of 2020.
